cause_quote: The commit added `<span class="new-session-page__unavailable-status">` before the existing `.session-menu__check` span, whose reserved 20px width pushed the new label inward even when the check was empty.
user_saw: In the New Session environment picker, the Unavailable label sat farther from the right edge than the selection checkmark and add icons.
summary: The fix hides empty check slots on unavailable rows, restores the shared 14px checkmark size, and adjusts the add buttons’ right margin.
reasoning: The parent of #170456 already reserved space for empty checkmarks and had no inline Unavailable label, so the label shipped with the extra inset. The later Solid rewrite preserved that element order, and the fix also adjusts an older add-button offset introduced by #146059.
